Recorded claim:
`syncReviewCheckoutFromWorking()` validates Working/Review Firefox and nested `comm` graphs before destructive commands. It requires exact `SYNC REVIEW`, rejects tracked Working changes as `source-dirty`, and never copies Working uncommitted changes. [Task 1]
